definitions.name: dao_interface_state_Config
definitions.description: Top level config type for core module.

automatically_add_cw20s.description:
If true the contract will automatically add received cw20
tokens to its treasury.

automatically_add_cw721s.description:
If true the contract will automatically add received cw721
tokens to its treasury.

dao_uri.description:
The URI for the DAO as defined by the DAOstar standard
<https://daostar.one/EIP>

image_url.description: An optional image URL for displaying alongside the contract.
